rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something in a luxurious or opulent way.

example.english: They decorated the banquet hall opulently, leaving all the guests stunned.
example.traditional: 佢將個宴會廳布置到豪華咁，成班客都睇到呆咗。
